# Page title: Address Books and Address Sets | Junos OS | Juniper Networks
# Source type: documentation
# Documentation set (page metadata): junos current
# Junos release shown: not stated
# Retrieved: 2026-10-06
# Assumptions: HIER-1 (hierarchical format)
# Note: 'show security address-book': address sets, a container-form address with dns-name, attach, a global book.
# Note: Text copied verbatim from the page <pre> block (line endings normalized).
# ---
[edit]
user@host# show security zones
    security-zone trust {
        
        interfaces {
            ge-0/0/0.0;
        }
    }
    security-zone untrust {
        interfaces {
            ge-0/0/1.0;
        }
    }
[edit]
user@host# show security address-book
        Eng-dept {
            address a1 203.0.113.1/32;
            address a2 203.0.113.2/32;
            address a3 203.0.113.3/32;
            address a4 203.0.113.4/32;
            address-set sw-eng {
                address a1;
                address a2;
            }
            address-set hw-eng {
                address a3;
                address a4;
            }
            attach {
                zone trust;
            }
        }
            Web {
                address Intranet {
                    dns-name www-int.device1.example.com;
                }
                attach {
                    zone untrust;
                }
            }
            global {
                address g1 198.51.100.2/32;
            }
